setup_notes: Monorepo layout with npm workspaces (backend/, frontend/) — root package.json scripts (install, db-setup, dev, test) serve as the setup task runner
Backend uses CommonJS (not ESM) for straightforward Jest compatibility; frontend uses ESM (Vite convention)
Auth middleware and auth-store were intentionally skipped — shared-decisions.auth.mechanism is 'None (no authentication)'
Pagination helper was intentionally skipped — shared-decisions.pagination.strategy is 'None (all results returned)'
backend/prisma/schema.prisma contains ASDLC_MODELS_START/END markers for entity-models-agent to insert model blocks
backend/src/index.js contains ASDLC_ROUTES_START/END markers for screen route registration
Frontend test framework is Vitest (Vite-native, Jest-compatible API) — arch-spec's 'Jest + Supertest' choice applies to the backend
